title: Law to expand NYCHA business training beyond catering and childcare
summary: This bill would require the Department of Small Business Services, working with NYCHA's Office of Resident Economic Empowerment and Sustainability, to expand its Business Pathways program for public housing residents to include creative fields, retail and cosmetology alongside catering and childcare. The free program would offer business education, mentorship, licensing support, marketing and financial guidance, safety training funding and help finding commercial space. The law would take effect 120 days after enactment.
